title: Race-specific climbs 2x10min (Presolana)
terrain: Presolana, climb of 10min+ at 8-12% with runnable descent, ~400m D+

steps.target: Z3-Z4, 163-170bpm, climb at race effort, hike over 15%
Z2-Z3, 140-160bpm, descent at race effort, 172+ spm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 20m easy, 2x(10min climb at 163-170bpm + 10min descent at race effort, 172+ spm), 10m easy. ~1h10, ~400m D+. Morning, before the evening flight.
GYM: none.
FUEL: Tailwind 500ml + 1 gel at 40min (race kit check).
GARMIN: ~65.
STOP RULE: HRV under 50 or RHR 52+ = 1 climb, descents easy. HR over 172 on a climb = hike. No 3rd rep.
WHY: amber Sun 1 (HRV -23) and feel 5 Sat: keep the race-pace touch, drop the volume. D-5, CTL already 56.2.
